Setsuna Tokage (Sports Festival).name: Setsuna Tokage (Sports Festival)
Setsuna Tokage (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Setsuna Tokage, hero name Lizardy, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and one of 1-B's recommended entrants. She competed at the Sports Festival without reaching the final tournament, as talkative before a stadium as in a lecture. Loose moss-green hair, a sharp-toothed grin; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Fast, chatty, teasing; candid opinions nobody asked for.
Combat Role: Scout and harrier whose floating pieces spot, distract and surround.
Under Pressure: Talks faster and improvises.
Setsuna Tokage (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She loves a crowd and a challenge, and the festival handed both to 1-A. Motivation: Her share of the scouts' attention. Concealment: Playing background to Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu, 1-A's recommended pair, needles her. Connections: Neito Monoma, whose festival taunting of 1-A she enjoyed. Knowledge: Knows of the USJ attack on 1-A only secondhand. Thread: Whether 1-B gets noticed for its own strengths.
QUIRK: Lizard Tail Splitter, unchanged.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Lizardy.
personality: Chatterbox: Kept up a running commentary through every event, cameras or not.
Confident: Takes the active role in a team event and expects to make it work.
Overconfident: A failed read leaves her briefly unsettled before she regroups.
Speaking style: Lively, direct banter and quick instructions; talks fast, laughs easily, thinks out loud.
abilities: Body division: Splits into as many as fifty floating pieces; a piece caught or hit is her caught or hit.
Reconnaissance: Sends pieces around cover to watch; a spotted piece gets swatted.
Multiple angles: Pieces distract, surround or pin a target; more distraction than damage.
Running banter: Talks through a contest to needle an opponent's focus; useless on the patient.
Fighting style: Scatters to scout and distract, harries from every side, and sets up holds or ring-outs.
Setsuna Tokage (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young woman with loose moss-green hair parted at the center, bright green eyes, fair skin and a medium build. Her wide grin shows a row of small, sharp pointed teeth. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Cheeky, competitive expression.
